summary: Completed comprehensive frontend testing of The Camden Lane cafe website. All major functionality working correctly including navigation, sections, images, and responsive design.

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile menu close button has overlay interception issue - clicking to close menu is blocked by menu overlay
ui_bugs.impact: Minor UX issue - users can still navigate using menu links to close menu

design_issues.issue: GSAP and ScrollTrigger showing as undefined in JavaScript evaluation, though animations are visually working
design_issues.impact: Animations work correctly but library detection fails in automated tests

passed_tests: Hero section displays with cafe name 'The Camden Lane' and slogan
Navigation bar with all 5 links (Home, About, Menu, Gallery, Contact) working
Smooth scrolling navigation to all sections working
About section with story content and interior image loading
Menu section with 3 signature dishes (Mediterranean Bowl, Signature Latte Art, The Camden Feast) displaying correctly
Gallery section with 5 images loading and displaying properly
Contact section with location (Koregaon Park, Pune), hours, phone, email details
Footer with branding and navigation links

All 10 images loading correctly across all sections
